# Reused inputs

Only the two main BRCA2 score exports and their explicitly documented derived
mapping may be bundled here under the source records' CC0 terms. Other inputs
are intentionally retrieved from their original repositories. Do not apply
the root MIT or the authors' CC BY 4.0 grant to upstream material.

Use the acquisition commands and input contracts in `docs/REPRODUCING.md`.
`sources.csv` records exact locations, hashes where available, and access scope.
An upstream file that no longer matches its frozen hash must be investigated;
do not silently accept a newer file as the historical input.

Downloaded inputs and newly generated results are ignored by Git by default.
